nodes.label: Compact-at-rest / spring pop-up dock
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.rationale: Default compact scale 0.88 comes from the aim rule: the aimed tab must stay under a still pointer, worst case 39 px shift vs 51 px half-width; 0.84 was borderline (52 vs 51 px) and dropped clicks. Deliberately reverses Stage 5's no-scaling choice while keeping its no-hover-jump guarantee.

nodes.label: Frosted-glass dock styling
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.rationale: Glass was tuned by measurement, not taste: 62% tint with blur 18 gave only 2.8:1 muted-label contrast; the chosen 78% tint, blur 20, saturate 1.5, brightness 0.6 gives 5.0:1 over realistic content and 4.8:1 over a teal strip.

nodes.label: Unscaled natural-footprint hover area (::before)
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.rationale: Transforms do not change layout, so a ::before on the unscaled wrapper keeps the dock's NATURAL footprint as hover area — growth starts before the pointer reaches the visible compact dock, and the sticky-bar clearance stays unchanged.

nodes.label: 190 ms settle gate on tab reactions
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.norm_label: 190 ms settle gate on tab reactions
nodes.rationale: Tabs ignore the pointer (is-settling) until the dock reaches its size so a moving tab never causes the wrong tab to react; the spring needs 175–197 ms to reach 99% of size, so 190 ms must not be lowered.

nodes.label: Rules for chatbots without repo tools
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.norm_label: rules for chatbots without repo tools
nodes.rationale: Chatbots cannot push, so each changed file is delivered as a copyable block with its Conventional Commit message; repo access stays read-only unless the current request grants write permission.

nodes.label: Layered solution architecture (Web/Api/Services/Dal/Models/Tests)
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.rationale: Code stays in the layer that owns it; AddMobileShop(...) is the single DI composition root, and UseApi=false keeps the normal DAL data-service path.

nodes.label: Plaintext Apple ID inventory passwords (by design)
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.norm_label: plaintext apple id inventory passwords (by design)
nodes.rationale: The shop must recover Apple ID inventory passwords for customers, so they are never hashed, encrypted or hidden; application-user passwords are separate and stay hashed.

nodes.label: Native AOT not enabled
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.rationale: This application uses Razor Pages/MVC, which is not supported by ASP.NET Core Native AOT, so publishing stays self-contained single-file instead.

nodes.label: Security and production-readiness notes
nodes.community_name: Stage 6 plan — frosted-glass compact/pop-up navigation dock
nodes.rationale: Not production-hardened: no production-grade authentication or authorization — treat it as a single-shop tool on a trusted network.
